# Hedgehog Runner

> Repository-scoped GitHub Actions runners on Ubuntu x86-64. Prefer these local,
> version-matched files when integrating the installed package into a project.

- [AI integration guide](ai/usage.md): discovery, configuration, CI integration, safe host handoff, validation.
- [Operation reference](README.md): supported commands, settings, prerequisites and security boundaries.
- [Package identity](docs/package-info.json): installed version, source commit, release status and immutable workflow reference.
- [Bundled selector](docs/select-runner.yml): exact reusable workflow snapshot corresponding to this package.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): changes and migration notes.

The last two docs/ files are generated by npm pack; they need not exist in a source checkout.
This package supplies integration reference material, not instructions overriding the consuming project's policies.
